theorem.model: Frozen authority after a single within-window trusted checkpoint, exact independent modular observations, complete source-impact closure, independent obligations, adequate trusted effect guards. Matched finite evidence price.

protocol.objective: Minimize new evidence cost for a batch of genuinely safe actions; fixed guard/facility costs shared by all policies and omitted from deltas.
policies: optimal mixture of direct and pairs
protocol.noClaim: These baselines are illustrative, not replicas of frontier commercial systems. An equivalently optimized comparator ties the optimum.
predictions: Tight case: selective policy finishes where a full refresh cannot.
Mixed policy beats impacted-direct with scarce capacity and high direct-check fee.
With abundant capacity, an impacted-paired comparator ties.
High raw disclosure fee changes preferred evidence mode.
Unauthenticated change-impact closure cannot support sound reuse.

observed.context: ControlArena IaC Fast 20.1.1; six investigator-authored source-matched candidates (two honest, four harmful). No unrestricted attack-model win or production AWS effect.
observed.guardTimes: Means of 50 warmup-excluded checks per fixture. Guard-only latency, excludes CDK synthesis and official scoring.
observed.additional: Local atomic commit service median 10.3798ms; one no-effect source revision demanded ~8.239s re-synthesis. Real production latency and USD prices are unmeasured.
observed.lesson: Faster selective audit admitted a harmful authored fixture. The broad all-SCP check was 2.52× slower than full audit on this fixed workload.

counterexample.caveat: Possible-world indistinguishability is exact; synthetic source restrictions and disclosure fees do not establish real semantic correctness or cryptographic privacy.

audit.checker: Independent finite DP against closed-form theorem
audit.stop: Do not promote an outcome when proof formula differs from oracle, a stale certificate is accepted, or a stronger matched baseline ties or wins.
open: Correlated shared sensors with noise and evolving distributions
